The attestation identifies the order, date, person, and approval event unambiguously. It does not merely say that approval was requested or that Mara expected approval. This statement is positive testimony about the event. The scan records the statement and its signature; it does not provide the allegedly examined approval document itself. [AQ2] Records officer Tomas Reed signed a second attestation on June 28 at 14:38 UTC. It reads: The 5 1 2 1 2 3 226 201 105 17 96.269058 director 5 1 2 1 2 4 347 201 90 23 96.737183 granted 5 1 2 1 2 5 454 206 23 12 96.570763 no 5 1 2 1 2 6 494 201 104 23 96.501373 approval 5 1 2 1 2 7 615 201 36 17 93.283287 for 5 1 2 1 2 8 667 202 51 16 90.689674 P-21 5 1 2 1 2 9 734 203 23 15 96.387871 at 5 1 2 1 2 10 774 206 24 12 96.807312 or 5 1 2 1 2 11 814 201 76 17 93.297821 before 5 1 2 1 2 12 909 202 62 16 84.386948 11:0@ 5 1 2 1 2 13 988 202 38 16 96.398415 UTC 5 1 2 1 2 14 1040 206 25 12 95.571106 on 5 1 2 1 2 15 1081 202 49 16 95.571106 June 5 1 2 1 2 16 1148 202 33 16 96.616051 27. 4 1 2 1 3 0 68 241 1130 23 -1 5 1 2 1 3 1 68 242 22 16 96.033577 In 5 1 2 1 3 2 107 241 140 23 96.023750 particular, 5 1 2 1 3 3 266 241 37 17 96.365891 the 5 1 2 1 3 4 320 241 104 23 96.221344 reported 5 1 2 1 3 5 441 242 63 16 20.764076 10:00 5 1 2 1 3 6 521 241 104 23 96.572823 approval 5 1 2 1 3 7 639 241 38 17 96.823395 did 5 1 2 1 3 8 694 242 36 16 96.742531 not 5 1 2 1 3 9 747 242 89 16 96.369461 occur. This is an explicit denial of the same pre-commitment approval event asserted by Mara, not an observation that Tomas failed to locate one attachment. Tomas says he was the approval-session recorder but supplies no complete session transcript. The statement does not deny that the order was committed at 10:30, which both witnesses accept. It also does not suggest that a different person had delegated authority to approve P-21. [AQ3] The authenticity of both signatures is stipulated for this synthetic dossier. Neither witness has retracted the signed statement. No priority rule, adjudication, amended register, or original approval instrument resolving the disagreement is supplied. P-21 is deliberately outside the complete transaction coverage of L@1. Both statements concern the same order and same June 27 morning, so they cannot be reconciled by moving one to a different order, date, or timezone. Their contradiction concerns approval occurrence. An audit should not transform both attributed statements into unconditional world facts from which arbitrary conclusions could be derived; nor does signature authenticity make one statement automatically authoritative over the other. [AQ4] P-21 has normalized value EUR 8,000.00 and does not aggregate with another requirement. Its commitment record states 2029-06-27 10:30 UTC and identifies the supplier. Competition is therefore not the disputed issue. The provided attestation packet contains no invoice-payment entry, bank statement, or payment authorization. Even if a reviewer resolved the approval disagreement later, that resolution would not establish payment. The scans are faithful document reproductions prepared for this synthetic fixture. Their visual signatures are textual signature labels, not copied real signatures, and their evidentiary content is limited to the attributed assertions printed above.
